## What changes and why?

Describe the problem, intended behavior and scope. Link the relevant Seali issue, if any. Identify inherited behavior separately from new Seali work.

## Validation

List exact commands, versions/commit and results. Distinguish passed, failed, skipped and not run. Explain any limitation rather than marking an unperformed check as passed.

- [ ] Focused tests or a clear explanation of why no test applies
- [ ] For visual changes: actual screenshots or recordings and the tested device/environment, or an explicit unverified-layout note
- [ ] For user data, storage or identity changes: compatibility and migration effects checked
- [ ] For translations: placeholders, XML escaping and current release/support claims checked

## Safety and attribution

- [ ] No credentials, signing keys, cookies, personal data or private logs included
- [ ] Existing copyright, license and third-party credits preserved
- [ ] No unsupported claim that a build is stable, fully tested, accessible or security-qualified
- [ ] Dependency, workflow, permissions, artifact publication and deployment effects described, if changed

## Remaining work

Name unresolved failures, skipped checks, runtime/visual gaps and any follow-up needed before merge or release. A source change or green CI alone is not an installer or release qualification.
